reason: S1 removes the public helper h2o_timer_val_from_uint and changes h2o_timer_val_t to uint64_t, but H0 still calls h2o_timer_val_from_uint during one-time configuration. Consequently S1 + H0 cannot compile, so the fuzz entry point cannot reach any production behavior. S0 supplied the helper, making this gap commit-induced.
evidence: include/h2o/timer_val.h deletes static inline h2o_timer_val_from_uint(uint64_t val).

LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput calls h2o_timer_val_from_uint when assigning config.http2.idle_timeout, config.http1.req_timeout, config.proxy.io_timeout, config.proxy.connect_timeout, config.proxy.first_byte_timeout, and the corresponding proxy_config timeout fields.
S1 production call sites replace h2o_timer_val_from_uint(...) with direct integer assignments, while H0 retains the removed API calls.
recommended_action: Update LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput to assign integer timeout values directly to the h2o_timer_val_t fields, matching the S1 uint64_t API.
